import re
def order_changes(changes):
 d={};key=re.compile(r'[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*')
 for x in changes:
  if len(x)!=3 or not key.fullmatch(x[0]) or (x[1]!='-' and not key.fullmatch(x[1])) or x[0] in d:return None
  try:q=int(x[2])
  except:return None
  if str(q)!=x[2] or not 0<=q<=10000000 or x[1]==x[0]:return None
  d[x[0]]=(x[1],q)
 if any(p!='-' and p not in d for p,q in d.values()):return None
 o=[];done=set()
 while len(o)<len(d):
  r=sorted((q,n) for n,(p,q) in d.items() if n not in done and (p=='-' or p in done))
  if not r:return None
  n=r[0][1];done.add(n);o.append(n)
 return o
